The correct fractional part is `x - x0` [S1].

The evidence explicitly states that `x0 = int(np.floor(x))` and `x1 = int(np.floor(x) + 1)`. Consequently, `x1 - x0` equals 1. The code calculates `alpha = x - x0 / (x1 - x0)`. Due to operator precedence, this is evaluated as `x - (x0 / 1)`, which simplifies to `x - x0`. The evidence notes confirm that `x - x0` represents the fractional part of x. Therefore, the claim that the correct fractional part is `x - x0` is fully supported by the provided source code and analysis.
